best_for: PC and Mac players of Blizzard and Activision games such as World of Warcraft, Overwatch 2 or Call of Duty, who need the launcher to buy and start those games.
description:
Battle.net is the desktop app from Blizzard Entertainment, the studio behind Warcraft, Diablo, StarCraft, Overwatch and Hearthstone. It is where you launch Blizzard's games on a computer.

At the time of reading, Blizzard's PC lineup spanned World of Warcraft and its Classic edition, Diablo IV and the Lord of Hatred expansion, Hearthstone, StarCraft II and Heroes of the Storm. Older favorites are there too in newer form, such as Warcraft III: Reforged, Diablo II: Resurrected and remastered versions of the first two Warcraft games and StarCraft.

points.title: The launcher for Blizzard's store
points.text: Battle.net is the desktop app you start your Blizzard games from. It also holds the store, your friends list and a news feed with sales, trailers and patch notes.

points.title: Free games and trials inside
points.text: The download page points to free-to-play titles such as Overwatch 2 and Call of Duty: Warzone, plus free trials of other games. The app itself costs nothing; the store inside it sells games, expansions and digital gifts for friends.

points.title: Friends, chat and voice
points.text: You can add friends, send them messages and talk over voice chat from inside the app, without a separate chat program.

points.title: Turn on two-factor sign-in
points.text: Blizzard offers two-factor authentication for your Battle.net account and promotes it on the download page. There is also a Battle.net app for phones.

points.title: No Linux build
points.text: Blizzard offers the desktop app for Windows and macOS only, plus phones. There is no Linux download on the official page.

points.title: Only the current setup file
points.text: This site lists one version for Windows and one for macOS: the small setup program that installs the launcher. The Windows setup installs for the whole machine. There are no older launcher builds to roll back to here.
